title: TRUSTMEBRO: Vibecoded collaboration on reverse engineering!
author: EternalDisciple
selftext:
Since i really like the idea of decompiling only free software (trust me), i want to create a project that will allow me to collaborate with friends on the same software. Problem is, i dont have any idea what im doing, so i asked claude for help, he came up with,

TRUSTMEBRO: **T**eam-built **R**everse-engineering **U**sing **S**lop, **T**otally **M**ostly **E**xact, **B**inaries **R**ecreated **O**ptimistically

[https://github.com/LucaSammartino/TRUSTMEBRO](https://github.com/LucaSammartino/TRUSTMEBRO)

The idea is, one leader establishes the software, tools and their versions, and the rest follow, the leader hands out tasks, the rest carry them out, then they communicate their notes about the results of the carried out tasks.

There is minimun checking of work done so as to prevent double work, at the same time, its almost certain that the project will go tremendously horribly, and no work will get done. Since no one knows what they are doing, and they have tokens to spare, whats there to lose? It might be a fun project!
